traits.name: Aura of Righteousness
traits.text: (aura, divine, evocation); 20 feet. Allies in the planetar's aura gain a +2 status bonus to AC against evil creatures and a +2 status bonus to damage rolls against evil creatures. The area in the aura is difficult terrain for evil creatures.

traits.name: Blade of Justice
traits.text: ⬺ The planetar makes a greatsword Strike against a target it detects as evil. If the target is evil, the Strike deals three extra weapon damage dice and deals 1d6 (1d6) persistent good damage to the target. The planetar can convert all the physical damage from the attack into good damage.

traits.name: Change Shape
traits.text: ⬻ (concentrate, divine, polymorph, transmutation); The planetar can take on the appearance of any Small or Medium humanoid. This doesn't change their Speed or Strikes.

traits.name: Holy Armaments
traits.text: (divine, evocation); Any weapon gains the effect of a holy property rune while a planetar wields it.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ holy greatsword +32 (good, magical, versatile p); Damage 3d12+16 (3d12+16) slashing plus 1d6 (1d6) good
